facts.fact: CIPIT's analysis lists 'the ICT Policy' among Kenya's existing instruments that recognise inclusion but set no AI accessibility standards or enforcement mechanism; the document gives no adoption date, so the published date 2026-07-30 is used.

note: ICT Policy named without a description of its scope or date; the National AI Strategy 2025-2030 and the draft AI policy are subsector instruments and give no fact.
